name: Monitor vendor compliance documents and expiry dates with Google Drive, OpenAI and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Monitor vendor compliance documents and expiry dates with Google Drive, OpenAI and Google Sheets

### How it works

This workflow has two related flows for vendor compliance management. When a new Google Drive file arrives, it checks that it is a PDF, extracts text, uses OpenAI to identify document details, matches the document to a vendor, updates a Google Sheets document register, moves the file, and alerts Slack if review is needed. A separate daily schedule reads vendor and document data from Google Sheets, evaluates compliance and expiry status against tier requirements, logs results, sends vendor reminders, and posts/email a daily digest.

### Setup steps

- Connect Google Drive credentials and configure the trigger to watch the vendor document intake folder.
- Configure Google Drive folders or file operations for downloading incoming PDFs and moving processed files.
- Connect OpenAI credentials for the document information extraction node and tune the extraction schema/prompt if needed.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and set the spreadsheet IDs/ranges for vendor intake, vendor master data, document register, and compliance log sheets.
- Connect Slack credentials and choose channels for unsupported-file alerts, review-needed alerts, and daily summaries.
- Connect Gmail credentials for vendor reminder emails and the compliance-owner digest.
- Set the schedule trigger timezone and confirm the 8 AM run time, then update the Configuration node values such as companyName, complianceOwnerEmail, complianceInbox, and testMode.

### Customization

Adjust the tier requirements code to reflect the documents required for each vendor tier, and modify reminder timing, Slack channels, email templates, or review rules to match the organization’s compliance process.

## Drive intake check

Starts when a file is added to Google Drive, verifies whether it is a PDF, and sends a Slack notice for unsupported file types.

## Download and extract PDF

Downloads accepted PDF files from Google Drive and extracts their text content for downstream analysis.

## AI document extraction

Uses the OpenAI chat model through the information extractor to pull structured compliance document data from the PDF text.

## Prepare and match vendor

Combines Drive metadata with AI extraction results, reads the vendor intake sheet, and matches the document to the correct vendor while flagging validation issues.

## Register and archive document

Writes or updates the document register in Google Sheets and moves successfully processed files to the processed area in Google Drive.

## Review alert branch

Checks whether the matched document needs human review and posts a Slack alert when manual follow-up is required.

## Daily run configuration

Starts the scheduled daily compliance check and sets company-level configuration plus tier requirement definitions.

## Load compliance data

Reads vendor and document data from Google Sheets to provide the inputs for the daily compliance evaluation.

## Evaluate and log compliance

Evaluates active vendors against required documents and expiry dates, then appends the compliance results to the log sheet.

## Vendor reminder emails

Filters compliance results to vendors with reminders due and sends reminder emails through Gmail.

## Daily digest notifications

Builds the daily compliance digest and sends it to the compliance owner by email and to Slack as a summary.

options.systemPromptTemplate: You are a vendor compliance analyst. Classify the document and extract the requested fields. Use only information present in the document; return an empty string when a field is not present. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD. SOC 2: issue_date = end of the audit period. NEVER output bank account numbers, IBANs, routing numbers, SWIFT codes, tax ID numbers or other identifiers - describe them only (e.g. 'bank letter from HBL'). If the text is empty or unreadable, set confidence to 0.
